test_case.test_name: Parameterized MLPerf DLRM-v2 99.9 high-accuracy Server validation
test_case.purpose: Produce a compliant DLRM-v2 99.9 high-accuracy Server result and compare it with a matched MLCommons v4.0 reference.
required_package: Licensed v4.0 harness/LoadGen/container and DLRM-v2 99.9 model/data/calibration/config
Server load schedule, latency target and accuracy/validity settings
Comparable reference and approved score delta
test_case.test_command: Validate hashes/licenses, assets, GPU visibility and baseline; execute the supported equivalent of `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=dlrm-v2 --scenarios=server --config_ver=high_accuracy"`; preserve accuracy, LoadGen validity/detail/summary, throughput/P99 and telemetry; restore settings and compare only with the bound matched DLRM-v2 99.9 Server reference.
test_case.expected_result: High-accuracy target and Server validity pass; throughput/latency meets the approved reference delta; platform remains healthy and cleanup completes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact DLRM-v2 99.9 high_accuracy Server identity, compliant accuracy/validity and approved comparison. BERT/Offline output, invalid run or missing threshold cannot pass.
safety_gate: Verify high_accuracy Server configuration before launch.
Abort on validity, thermal/power/ECC or stability limit.
Preserve all logs; do not claim official submission status.
test_case.recovery: Stop invalid/unhealthy runs, preserve all evidence, remove only test-created state, restore runtime/power settings and verify GPUs before any new approval.
